string.text: This is the encyclopedia. As you progress in the game, information about the world around you will be added here, sorted by topic.
The Encyclopedia
Factory Bandit's PDA
Trader: get inside the army outpost and steal the case containing the report of the military expedition to the northern part of the Zone.
Dead Rookie's PDA
Fanatic: "Help us defend against the Mercs. The plan goes like that. Everyone hides, so the camp looks deserted, we let the Mercs inside the camp, then attack on captain's order."
Guide's PDA
Meeting Doctor
ドクター「ストレロクと仲間たちが使っていた隠し場所で、ストレロクの使いを待つ。こちらの仲間なら、場所は分かるはずだ」
OK, I'll meet with Ghost's man. I will be waiting for him in Strelok's hiding place. If he's one of our own, he will know where to look for me. Doctor.

商人「俺の連中が仕事の帰りに行方をくらました。そのうちの1人、ニンブルが情報を運んでいたんだ。橋を越え損ねて、すぐ近くで消息を絶ったらしい。何があったのか見当もつかん。とにかくニンブルを探せ。生きていようが死んでいようが、フラッシュドライブさえ持っていればいい。そいつを俺に届けてくれ。ニンブルはウルフの部下だ。ウルフならこのキャンプにいるから、話を聞け。何か知っているだろうし、武器や装備も用意してくれるはずだ」
Seriy to Fox: "A friend wants me to give a helping hand to a bunch of stalkers that dug out Strelok's stash. I'm off to the hangar at the Garbage with my boys. That's where you can find me."
Yesterday one brother went to scout the deserted mill and we haven't heard from him since. We need to go there and see where he disappeared to.

Wolf: "Bring the dynamite stolen by the bandits at the factory. To help you, there are scouts under the bridge, come to them and say "Hello from the underworld" - that's the password. Lead them into battle."
Wolf: "Clear the bandits at the factory with the help of my scouts behind the bridge, then return and report."
Dead Stalker's PDA
誰かの住みかで意識が戻った。何も思い出せない。手元にあるのは、見知らぬ男の写真が入ったPDAだけだ。そこには、ただ1つの指示が残されている――ストレロクを殺せ。
商人「フォックスが探索から戻ってきて、助けを求めている。ストレロクについて何か知っているかもしれん」
フォックス「セリーはガーベジの格納庫にいる。ストレロクのことなら、あいつの方が詳しい」
Trader: "Steal the expedition report from the military at the Agroprom Research Institute, take it to the 100 Rads bar and give it to the Barkeep."
Fox's PDA

Nimble's diary. 
 
"Trader sent us to spy on the military at the Agroprom Research Institute. Got there and shot everybody, bandits and military alike. Dug out some interesting stuff, I'm encoding the rest."

Seriy to Fox: "One guy I know asked to meet a group of stalkers who sniffed out Strelok's hiding place. I'll be at the Garbage, come over if you want."
Nimble's PDA

Well, well... Artifacts... Everybody's looking and hunting for them here. They say, one can become rich by selling them, and besides they have remarkable attributes... Anyway, I must find my first artifact.
There's a very strange anomaly here. It looks like it's moving. I'll try to calculate its movement times and path, because I don't have the cash to pay the soldiers for passage.
I left a small stash at the deserted farm. It's got some food and ammo. I'm way too weak to carry it now. I'm not sure if I can make it to the camp.
ウルフに、バンディットの駐車場からダイナマイトの箱を持ってくるよう頼まれた。煙突を調べてみると何かありそうな気がする。

商人「客から『ダミー』のアーティファクト一式を届けてほしいと頼まれた。
必要なのは次の物だ。 
 『ママズ・ビーズ』 
 『ペリクル』 
 『バッテリー』 
 『スプリング』 
 『シェル』 
簡単な仕事じゃないのは分かっている。急がせるつもりはない。
シドロヴィッチ」

At first there were only five of us, those most desperate and willing to do anything for the Truth. Why do we want to go there, anyway? What do we want to discover there? None of us know, not Green, not Romantic, not me, not even the Captain. I did not ask anyone, but simply decided for myself: to imagine that there, in the Center of the Zone - lays a brighter future. A chance for a good life which I had beyond the perimeter, and which my enemies ruined. Let it be so, and if not, I can take a bullet to the head.\n \n %c[255,255,128,0]I stashed some goodies under a spruce on a high hill north-east of the carpark infested with bandits.%c[default]

We are making heavy preparations for the expedition to the North. With the money raised from the sale of our loot, we acquire supplies, weapons and ammunition by the crate-load. Duty helped us a little with this - they threw in a couple of old maps and some spare ammunition. We should also make note of a new contributor - a veteran nicknamed Raven. He came to our leader and on behalf of the Hunters' community presented us with a set of armor and weapon repair kits. I think they will definitely be of use in the future. I wish there were more like-minded people! The captain tried to persuade Raven to join our expedition, but he declined, since he seems to be suffering from health problems after the mutant attack.\n \n %c[255,255,128,0]I hid some of my gear near the fence on the north side of the newcomers' camp, under a large dry bush.%c[default]
The stash should be in this area, the possible margin of geographical error - 20-30 meters.

Subject: A stalker named Strelok. 
 Approximate physical description: Short stature, thin build, haggard appearance. Receding hairline, black hair, sharp nose, gray eyes. No image available, description gathered from secondary HUMINT sources, reliability questionable. 
 Exercise extreme caution at contact: intel indicates the subject is highly trained and experienced in combat, prior military experience likely although unconfirmed. Subject has a legendary reputation with the locals due to his apparently successful attempts at penetrating into the CNPP premises. 
 Primary Objective: Locate and secure dead drop containing equipment considered essential for operation in the AO. The cache is camouflaged in accordance with SOP and located 2km NNE, Azimuth 20 degrees, from the point of insertion. Approximate location marked on GPS with radial geographical margin of error between 10-20m.
